Now they can do anything forever and a breach exposes everything. OAuth replaces that with a valet key. The app redirects you to Google. You log in with Google and not the app. Google asks, "Allow this app to see your email and name?" You approve and Google hands the app a limited access token, not your password. The app uses that token, which is scoped to only what you allowed and can be revoked anytime. The app never sees your credentials. So OAuth is a valet key, access without the master key.
